notes: Auth login goes through the identity pack's own bespoke /api/auth/login endpoint, which is not part of the invocations catalog and touches no concept field directly (username/password/tenantId are auth request params, not a read of identity::User or Usuario). All 4 draft 'reads' were false positives: 'DocumentoFiscal.chave' matched the unrelated Portuguese word 'chave' (key) in a note string; 'identity::Role.name'/'workspace::Menu.label' are the recurring shell.js-chrome token collision already corrected in the pre-existing confirmed manifests; 'identity::User.username' matched the local JS variable 'username', not a field read through any cataloged route.
